title: Fix the wrong hint
prompt: The starter hints `half` as an int, so 7 / 2.0 is cut to 3 and the test fails. Change the hint to float so half_of_seven returns 3.5.
hints: A variable hinted int cannot hold a decimal; Godot converts and loses it.

docs.name: var name: int = value
docs.what: Declares a variable that can only hold that type. Also float, String, bool, Vector2, Array.
